    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Defensive access to observation fields
    # Common fields across modes
    resource_pos = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemy_pos = observation.get('enemies', [])
    ally_pos = observation.get('allies', [])
    my_pos = observation.get('player', {}).get('pos', (0, 0))
    grid_size = observation.get('grid_size', (10, 10))
    # Specific flags
    mode = observation.get('mode', '')

    # Helper function to compute Manhattan distance
    def dist(a, b):
        return abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1])

    # Determine target based on mode
    if mode == 'resource_collection':
        # Seek nearest resource
        if resource_pos:
            target = min(resource_pos, key=lambda p: dist(my_pos, p))
            dx = (target[0] > my_pos[0]) - (target[0] < my_pos[0])
            dy = (target[1] > my_pos[1]) - (target[1] < my_pos[1])
        else:
            # No resources, default to stationary
            dx, dy = 0, 0

    elif mode == 'pursuit_evasion':
        # Pursue nearest enemy
        if enemy_pos:
            target = min(enemy_pos, key=lambda p: dist(my_pos, p))
            dx = (target[0] > my_pos[0]) - (target[0] < my_pos[0])
            dy = (target[1] > my_pos[1]) - (target[1] < my_pos[1])
        else:
            # No enemies, stay put
            dx, dy = 0, 0

    elif mode == 'territory_control':
        # Move towards center of grid to control territory
        center = (grid_size[0] // 2, grid_size[1] // 2)
        dx = (center[0] > my_pos[0]) - (center[0] < my_pos[0])
        dy = (center[1] > my_pos[1]) - (center[1] < my_pos[1])
        # Limit to -1, 0, 1
        dx = max(-1, min(1, dx))
        dy = max(-1, min(1, dy))
    else:
        # Unknown mode: stay still
        dx, dy = 0, 0

    return [dx, dy]
